instruction:
Reconstruct the final tower described by these successive speech messages from one trial. Later messages can correct earlier ones. A correction that depends on an unseen Builder state may remain ambiguous.

Message 1: All right, so this is the construction that from your perspective it uses the blue brick and the two red column bricks stacked on top of it, and it looks like a capital J from your perspective. But this time it's on the back row of the 2x2 grid, so furthest away from you.

assumptions: The blue block is oriented along the x-axis to form the horizontal base of the 'J' shape.
The red stack is placed on the right end of the blue block to form a 'J' shape from the viewer's perspective.
The red blocks are centered on the blue block's footprint in the x and z dimensions where they are placed.
evidence: blue brick and the two red column bricks stacked on top of it
looks like a capital J from your perspective
on the back row of the 2x2 grid, so furthest away from you
